description:
Port model-selector.ts (~338 LOC). Overlay dialog for choosing the active model.

Implement:

- Show model metadata (context window, cost, capabilities)

- Triggered by /model command or Ctrl+M keybinding

Upstream: interactive/components/model-selector.ts, scoped-models-selector.ts
Depends on: overlay system, select_list, theme, autocomplete (for /model trigger)
